This app keeps everything on your device. No servers, no cloud, no ads, no trackers.
Privacy Shield is a privacy monitor, not an antivirus. It watches how apps use your camera, microphone, location and sensitive permissions, and explains what is happening in plain language.
All logs are stored locally in an on-device database. The app contains no networking code, no cloud services, no advertising and no tracking. Exports are shared only where you choose.

Android does not allow a regular app to block another app\'s access to the camera or microphone. When direct blocking is not possible, this app clearly tells you it detected the activity, explains it, and offers options such as opening the app\'s settings to force-stop it or revoke the permission — and points you to the system sensor switches.

Real-time detection uses Android\'s app-operations API (Android 11+) to learn when any app starts or stops using the camera, microphone or location. Permission changes are found by periodically comparing what each app is granted. Everything runs efficiently in a single lightweight foreground service.
